name: attach a red image
eval: const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=128; c.height=128; const x=c.getContext('2d'); x.fillStyle='#e00000'; x.fillRect(0,0,128,128); const blob=await new Promise(r=>c.toBlob(r,'image/png')); const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([blob],'carre.png',{type:'image/png'})); const i=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]')].find(i=>i.closest('.composer')); i.files=dt.files; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); return document.querySelectorAll('.composer img').length

name: ask the colour
eval: T.ask('De quelle couleur est cette image ? Réponds en un mot.'); return true

name: viewer opens
eval: document.querySelector('.message.user img').closest('button,a,img').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return !!document.querySelector('.viewer, .lightbox, dialog[open], .dialog')

name: close viewer
eval: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape'})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const b=document.querySelector('.viewer button, .lightbox button'); if (document.querySelector('.viewer, .lightbox') && b) b.click(); return true

name: project with an image
eval: document.querySelector('.item.new-item').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const d=document.querySelector('.dialog'); d.querySelector('input').value='Projet image'; [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.classList.contains('primary')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=128; c.height=128; const x=c.getContext('2d'); x.fillStyle='#0040e0'; x.fillRect(0,0,128,128); const blob=await new Promise(r=>c.toBlob(r,'image/png')); const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([blob],'bleu.png',{type:'image/png'})); const inp=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]')].find(i=>!i.closest('.composer')); inp.files=dt.files; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); return document.querySelector('main').innerText.includes('bleu.png')
